project.purpose: Bind exact security subjects to provider-native evidence, freshness/applicability, policy decisions, and standing projections while external tools own scanning/vulnerability/policy mechanics.

nodes.label: SubjectIdentity
nodes.responsibility: Bind the exact code/package/system subject under security evaluation.
acceptance: Evidence cannot silently drift to another subject.

nodes.label: ProviderEvidence
nodes.responsibility: Retain provider-native SARIF/SBOM/OSV/decision outputs through digest-bound EvidenceRef records.

nodes.label: Applicability
nodes.responsibility: Bind freshness/applicability/admission context supplied by owner/provider.
acceptance: The Security owner verification refuses a stale uv.lock before consuming locked dependencies.

nodes.label: PolicyDecision
nodes.responsibility: Compose bounded policy input and external OPA/Rego decision without cloning the policy engine.
acceptance: Policy effect is traceable to exact evidence/context.
inputs: Qualified owner-supplied policy input, normalized Security admission context and selected native OPA/Rego policy.
outputs: Source-qualified bounded policy decision or explicit policy/evidence error, not external effect truth.
behavioralContract: A policy decision cannot be upgraded to execution authority, resource acceptance, or proof of a specific Gateway installed consumer.
S06 and S07 are independently observable agent/principal and effect-admission sub-obligations composed using existing pinned OPA; no proprietary policy engine.

nodes.label: StandingProjection
nodes.responsibility: Project current security standing without claiming that tool installation/selection equals admission.
acceptance: Selected providers remain distinct from admitted/accepted coverage.

nodes.label: AgentGrantAndPrincipalAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate the qualified Agent Principal/Grant, action and risk/approval conditions to return ALLOW, DENY or STEP_UP, without executing any external effect.
nodes.authority: Security policy via mature OPA/Rego; source-only contract
inputs: Schema-qualified normalized agent admission request, exact principal, action, audience, grant, risk and approval fields.
outputs: Agent admission outcome ALLOW/DENY/STEP_UP, reason and authorityProjection only when admitted.
behavioralContract: The pinned OPA Agent Admission must reject unknown/invalid input schema and ungranted actions; STEP_UP and DENY cannot furnish an authority projection usable for effects.
Successful policy evaluation establishes only the scoped model decision under the exact input and policy bytes; it does not prove caller identity was really verified at ingress.
acceptance: Original Security Agent Admission tests verify ALLOW/STEP_UP/DENY and that non-ALLOW returns no effect admission; input schema negative tests fail closed.
The stand-alone Gateway capability AuthZ v1 reference calls this contract, but cannot be assumed compatible with the current Gateway v2/v3 middleware.

nodes.label: EffectAuthorityGateAfterAgentAllow
nodes.responsibility: Run existing OPA effect-admission on the exact authorityProjection only after S06 ALLOW; keep action/resource evidence separate from a physical effect or provider acceptance.
nodes.authority: Security effect policy via mature OPA/Rego; source-only contract
inputs: S06 ALLOW authorityProjection (exact actorId, authorityId, authorityDigest, zoneRef and capability) and effect-admission policy.
outputs: Scoped admitted/non-admitted effect policy result or fail-closed error; no effect result for DENY/STEP_UP.
behavioralContract: Only S06 ALLOW with a complete authorityProjection can initiate effect-policy evaluation; missing projection under ALLOW must fail rather than fabricate default permission.
The effect policy decision is not a Runtime receipt, a Gateway execution acknowledgment or confirmation that an external provider changed state.
acceptance: Security native positive and negative admission tests establish no effect result on DENY/STEP_UP and exact effect request identity on ALLOW.
Gateway Security v1 evaluator may consume this source decision as a reference, not as a current deployed v2/v3 authorization binding.

edges.label: existing policy decision decomposes into independently falsifiable Principal/Grant admission
existing decision composes qualified Effect admission without new engine
only S06 ALLOW permits effect policy evaluation with bound authorityProjection

slices.objective: Admit additional selected P0 providers only from a concrete consumer/security gap, keeping selection distinct from production admission.
acceptance: The next provider addition names a consumer need, exact evidence contract, admission boundary, and independent acceptance; otherwise it remains selected-only.
slices.nextAction: Use current Scorecard selected/accepted-but-not-admitted standing as the first policy pressure test.

slices.objective: Bind transitive authority and compositional security claims to exact principals, service effects, configuration versions, and independent consumer tests.
acceptance: For each tested effect path, principal -> Tool -> service -> external resource authority is enumerated and bounded.
Substitution/composition of two locally valid LEGO nodes does not widen effective READ/WRITE/NETWORK/PERSIST/EFFECT sets.
Existing AS01-AS12/XAS13-XAS18 security lens is reused; no second policy engine or cross-owner authority registry is created.
S06 ALLOW policy authority and S07 effect admission remain separate from Gateway installed v2/v3 authorization resource identity and Runtime physical effects.
slices.nextAction: Qualify one high-risk MCP/Runtime/network consumer path with existing Security owner policy and evidence projection.

gaps: Selected P0/P1 providers are not automatically active/admitted capabilities.

2026-10-24 audit: empirical transitive authority coverage for selected real Agent consumers is UNKNOWN, not proof of a missing control; see docs/architecture/evidence/FORMAL_LEGO_ISSUE_CENSUS_20261024_R1.json.

2026-10-27 bounded cross-Owner source falsifier: platform/security/contracts/gateway-capability-authz-v1/evaluate.py emits schemaVersion=1 and omits requestedResource, while services/gateway/src/ordivon_gateway/capability_authz.py requires schemaVersion in {2,3} and exact requestedResource==server-derived resource; direct v1 response cannot satisfy current Gateway PEP, even if local Security v1 policy unit tests PASS. The current Gateway also supports a separate standard AuthZEN schemaVersion=3 adapter; no evidence shows retired v1 reference is installed as that adapter. This is source/schema mismatch, NOT evidence of a deployed authorization bypass.
S06/S07 model and native owner tests do not establish Gateway v2/v3 live policy PDP wiring, dynamic external principal currentness, or verification of effect occurrence.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.
